intro.h2: Professional Burger Sleeves for Your Food Business
intro.html:
Welcome to The Burger Sleeves, your trusted supplier of custom printed burger sleeves and sandwich wraps. We specialize in providing wholesale packaging solutions for restaurants, food trucks, cafes, and takeaway businesses across the UK, USA, Canada, Australia, and Europe.

Our burger sleeves are designed to keep your burgers fresh, secure, and mess-free while showcasing your brand with vibrant custom printing. Whether you need greaseproof burger wraps, branded sandwich sleeves, or custom food wraps, we deliver quality packaging that enhances your customer experience.

With minimum orders starting at just 100 units, free design consultation, and quick turnaround times, we make professional packaging accessible for businesses of all sizes.

printing.html:
Transform your burger sleeves into powerful marketing tools with our custom printing services. We offer full-color printing that brings your brand to life with sharp, vibrant graphics.

Available Printing Options:

Full Color CMYK Printing Achieve stunning, photo-quality prints with unlimited color options. Perfect for complex logos and detailed designs.

Pantone Color Matching Ensure perfect brand consistency with exact Pantone color matching for your corporate colors.

Coating Options

  • Gloss Finish: High-shine coating for vibrant colors
  • Matte Finish: Sophisticated, non-reflective appearance
  • Spot UV: Raised, glossy highlights on specific design elements

Design Elements You Can Include:

  • Company logo and branding
  • Social media handles and website
  • Promotional messages and offers
  • QR codes for digital menus or ordering
  • Nutritional information
  • Custom patterns and backgrounds

Our design team works with you to create eye-catching packaging that customers remember and share on social media.
